 Georges-Kevin N'Koudou faces favourite foe Al Ittihad as Abha search for lift 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Georges-Kevin N’Koudou heads into Friday’s clash with Al Ittihad seeking to jolt bottom-placed Abha ’s season, and there are few opponents he has punished more. The on-loan winger built a habit of deciding this fixture at Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz Sports City Stadium during his prolific Damac spell.
 “During the week, we worked a lot on that,” he said. “We saw that when there were corner-kicks, [Al Ittihad] weren’t 100 percent focused. I told Nico [Stanciu] to play fast because I saw I had time.” He spoke in a previous interview with the Saudi Pro League.
 OneFootball Videos
 Across 2023-24 and 2024-25 he struck 28 goals for Damac. Four arrived in four meetings with Al Ittihad at this ground, two braces sealed by stoppage-time winners, and a January 2025 screamer left Predrag Rajkovic rooted.
 N’Koudou joined Abha in September on loan from Diriyah Club and is yet to score in the RSL this season. Abha have two points from 10 matches and three straight defeats heading into Matchweek 12, when Jens Wissing’s fourth-placed title-chasers visit the same venue.
 “I have been used to playing against big players since I was 17, 18,” N’Koudou said. “I am not shy or scared to play. You still have to be able to express yourself, whoever the opponent - even when it is big players or big teams.”
